recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR-37679 follow-up is needed unless FHIR-I opens a new tracker for more examples or to revisit the later FHIR-51466/FHIR-52895 version-matching model.
issue_request: FHIR-37679 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Search. It asked whether canonical version searches using :above or :below were text/prefix matching, such as whether |1 could match 10.0, 21.0, or 2.1.0, and FHIR-I resolved that above/below for versions require a version-comparison mechanism where below is less-than and above is greater-than under that algorithm.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 1bcd09ca79aba31bbad941f372c0be3f34a54162, which changed source/search.html to add canonical-reference :above text and replace the FHIR-37679 pending placeholder under :below with known-version-scheme, unknown-scheme ignored/rejected, and greater-than/less-than comparison language.
additional_context: Related Published decisions FHIR-26370 and FHIR-27920 evolved the original extension phrasing into CanonicalResource.versionAlgorithm[x] and general versioning guidance. Later Applied issues FHIR-51466, FHIR-52895, and FHIR-46311 refined the same family: current search text allows specified or inferred version schemes, rejects or ignores unknown schemes, compares against the version scheme, excludes supplied-version matches, and keeps unmodified [canonical]|[version] exact-token matching.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/search.html already carries the canonical :above/:below behavior required for FHIR-37679, source/references.html supplies the current canonical version matching rules, and source/hierarchy.xml confirms search.html is active build source.
